question: How many patients who underwent testing in 1997 had protein levels outside the normal range?
evidence: underwent testing in 1997 refers to YEAR(DATE) = '1997'; protein levels within the normal range refers to tp > 6 and tp < 8.5
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE (ALB <= 6.0 OR ALB >= 8.5) AND STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '1997'

fail_candidates.candidate_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) 
FROM Laboratory L
INNER JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', L.Date) = '1997' 
AND (L.TP <= 6 OR L.TP >= 8.5)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '1997' 
AND (TP <= 6.0 OR TP >= 8.5)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '1997' 
AND TP IS NOT NULL 
AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) 
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.Date) = '1997'
AND (l.TP < 6 OR l.TP > 8.5)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory
WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '1997'
  AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.Date) = '1997'
  AND (l.TP < 6 OR l.TP > 8.5);
